name: Dragon Shaman (Marshal Archetype)
body:
Dragon shamans are marshals who derive their leadership skills and powers from their association or kinship with dragons.

Bonus Language: A dragon shaman can read and write draconic.

Breath Weapon (Su)

At 1st level, a dragon shaman gains a form of breath weapon granted by their draconic patron. The breath weapon can be expelled in either a 15-foot cone or 30-foot line chosen when the dragon shaman uses it. The damage type of the breath weapon is determined by their draconic patron, see below. The damage is 1d6 with a Reflex save DC (10 + 1/2 the dragon shaman’s class level + their Constitution modifier) for half.

The damage increases by 1d6 at 3rd level and every odd level thereafter. At 12th level, the range of the breath weapon increases to a 30-foot cone or a 60-foot line.

A dragon shaman may use their breath weapon a number of times per day equal to 1/2 their class level plus their Constitution modifier.

This ability replaces inspire action and vital inspiration.

Dragon Patron (Ex)

A certain dragon type grants the dragon shaman their power. Select any dragon type.

The damage type they apply to auras and their breath weapon is the elemental damage type dealt by the dragon’s breath weapon. If the dragon does not deal elemental damage, it may not be selected.

Draconic Aura (Su)

Instead of inspiring auras, the dragon shaman projects draconic power. The dragon shaman gains the following benefits instead of the auras granted by the marshal:

Discernment: A dragon shaman and all allies gain a morale bonus equal to their aura bonus to Appraise and Sense motive checks.
Magic Mastery: A dragon shaman and all allies gain a morale bonus equal to their aura bonus to spell attack rolls.
Power: A dragon shaman and all allies gain a morale bonus equal to their aura bonus to melee damage rolls.
Presence: A dragon shaman and all allies gain a morale bonus equal to their aura bonus to Bluff, Diplomacy, and Intimidate.
Resistance: A dragon shaman and all allies gain a resistance to the energy type from their dragon patron of 5 times their aura bonus.
Resolve: A dragon shaman and all allies gain their aura bonus to saving throws against paralysis, sleep, and fear effects.
Retribution: Any creature attacking a dragon shaman or an ally within the aura take 2 points of energy damage per aura bonus. The damage type is based on the dragon type selected with dragon patron.
Senses: A dragon shaman and all allies gain a morale bonus equal to their aura bonus to Perception and initiative checks.
Toughness: A dragon shaman and all allies gain DR/magic equal to the aura bonus.
Vigor: Creatures affected by this aura gain fast healing equal to the aura bonus but only as long as their hit point total is equal to or less than one one third their maximum hit points.
Dragon Magic (Sp)

At 4th level, a dragon shaman gains a 1st-level spell available to a sorcerer as a spell-like ability usable once per day.

This ability allows the dragon shaman to use spell completion items for that spell as if they were a spellcaster.

At 8th level, a dragon shaman gains a 3rd-level spell available to a sorcerer as a spell-like ability usable once per day. And gains an additional use of the 1st-level spell.

At 16th level, a dragon shaman gains a 4th-level spell available to a sorcerer as a spell-like ability usable once per day. And gains an additional use of the 1st- and 3rdlevel spell.

This ability replaces tactician and the bonus teamwork feats.

Natural Armor (Ex)

At 7th level, a dragon shaman grows some draconic scales gaining a +1 natural armor bonus to their AC. This increases by 1 at 11th level and every 4 levels thereafter.

This ability replaces inspiring voice and triple aura.

Major Draconic Auras (Su)

At 10th level, a dragon shaman gains more powerful auras instead of the auras granted by the marshal.

Elemental Empowerment: All elemental damage dealt by a dragon shaman and their allies that match the element from the dragon patron gain a bonus equal to the aura bonus.
Greater Resolve: This aura replaces resolve and instead grants immunity to paralysis, sleep, and fear effects produced by dragons. The aura bonus still applies to all other fear effects.
Greater Toughness: This aura replaces toughness and grants DR/– equal to the aura bonus.
Greater Vigor: This aura replaces vigor and grants fast healing to affected creatures as their hit point total is less than 50% of their maximum hit point total.
Immunity: This aura replaces resistance and grants immunity to the damage type from the dragon patron.
Magic Empowerment: A dragon shaman and their allies increase the DCs of their spells by 1/2 their aura bonus.
Commune with Draconic Patron (Sp)

At 12th level, a dragon shaman gains the ability to communicate with their draconic patron. This is effectively the commune spell, but it has no material requirement. The caster level for this effect is equal to the dragon shaman’s class level and it is only usable once per week.

This ability replaces greater tactician.

Draconic Wings (Ex)

At 19th level, a dragon shaman grows wings akin to those borne by their dragon patron. If their dragon patron does not have wings, like imperial dragons, the dragon shaman still gains the ability to fly. The flight granted has a speed of 60 feet with good maneuverability.

This ability replaces quadruple aura.
